title: Total Digestion of Marine Particles
author: Paulina Pinedo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f3wbqpe

steps.title: Prepare Filter in Vial
steps.instruction: Place the filter into a PFA vial, ideally with the sample side facing downwards or folded inwards.

steps.title: Initial Acid Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of sulfuric acid to all samples and blanks.

steps.title: Initial Peroxide Soak
steps.instruction: Soak the filter in sulfuric acid with the lid placed on loosely for 20 min at room temperature, then add 0.5 mL of hydrogen peroxide by lifting the lid slightly.

steps.title: First Heating Cycle
steps.instruction: React the mixture for 60 min on a hot plate at 110˚C with the lid placed on loosely.

steps.title: Second Heating Cycle
steps.instruction: Add another 0.5 mL of peroxide, replace caps loosely, and increase the hotplate temperature to 200˚C.

steps.title: Address Undissolved Material
steps.instruction: If undissolved filter pieces or semi-digested viscous material persist, let the vial cool down and add 100-200µL aliquots of peroxide to digest the material.

substeps.instruction: If a small droplet of sulfuric acid remains, let the vial cool.
Suspend contents in a small aliquot of Milli-Q water or 8N nitric acid.
Re-dry at 235˚C until the droplet is removed.

steps.title: Acid Resuspension and Heating
steps.instruction: Resuspend dried samples in 2 mL of a freshly prepared mixture of HNO3, HCl, and HF acids (4M each) in milli-Q water and heat for 4 hours at 100-110˚C.

steps.title: Cool and Dry
steps.instruction: Let vials cool to room temperature, uncap, and dry at 100-110˚C overnight.

steps.title: Second Peroxide Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of freshly prepared 50% HNO3 / 15% H2O2 (v/v) and take vials to dryness on a hotplate at 100-110˚C.

steps.title: Final Peroxide Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the sample in 200-500 µL of 50% HNO3 / 15% H2O2 (v/v), cap loosely, and heat at 110˚C.

substeps.instruction: Once vigorous bubbling ceases, uncap vials and dry at 135˚C.

steps.title: Final Nitric Acid Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL concentrated HNO3 and heat at 110˚C to dryness.

steps.title: Dilute for Analysis
steps.instruction: Dilute the sample to 5% of the original concentration with 0.1 M HNO3 for analysis.
